title: Beautiful 3BR Rosemary Beach Home with 4 Shared Pools
meta_description: Stay at A&P Cottage, a beautiful 3BR, 2.5BA Rosemary Beach cottage, with a gourmet kitchen, private beach access, and 4 community pools. Sleeps 6.
description_expanded: DescriptionA&P Cottage – A Rosemary Beach GemWhat Guests Love* 1-Minute Walk to Sky Pool* 4-Minute Walk to Beach Walkovers (F or E)* 4 Complimentary Bikes Included* Tesla Charger for Electric VehiclesDiscover the perfect blend of elegance and relaxation at A&P Cottage, a beautifully newly renovated getaway in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Every detail has been thoughtfully upgraded, from the stylish new tile and wall coverings in the 3 bathrooms to the high-end kitchen featuring state-of-the-art appliances, beautiful tile, and exquisite cabinetry. With its rich colors and dramatic details, it’s easy to see why Metropolitan Home awarded A&P Cottage the prestigious honor of Home of the Year in a past issue. This charming Rosemary Beach residence offers the perfect balance of relaxed elegance, making you feel right at home from the moment you step inside.Tucked away on a peaceful street off Scenic Highway 30A, A&P Cottage is just a short walk from the pristine white sand beaches and the emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Enjoy the quiet charm of the neighborhood parks, or stroll just one minute to the Town Center or the community’s iconic Sky Pool, all within walking distance. With everything 30A has to offer only steps away, this location is truly second to none.Home Layout2,104 Square Feet | Sleeps 6FIRST FLOOR:Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Separate Tub – Access to Outdoor Shower from Master BathGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with ShowerGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with ShowerSECOND FLOOR:Open Living Area with Ample Seating, Fireplace, and 55” OLED 4K TVGourmet Kitchen Overlooking the BalconyDining Area with Seating for 6Half Bath off the Living RoomBalcony with Comfortable SeatingTHIRD FLOOR:Covered Lounge Space with Private BalconyADDITIONAL AMENITIES:Off-Street Parking for 2 VehiclesApple TV, 55" OLED 4K TV and Sonos Sound SystemCOMMUNITY AMENITIES:4 Community Pools (1 Heated)Full-Service Spa Offering Massage Therapy, Facials, Nail Services, and MoreTennis Center with 8 Clay CourtsFitness Center with Top-of-the-Line Equipment and Certified Personal TrainingShopping and Dining Just Steps AwayTDT-019544
